description_en: Creates a BGP group for a specified Virtual Border Router (VBR)
description_zh: 为指定的边界路由器（VBR）创建一个BGP组
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-bgp-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --router-id vbr-bp1ctxy813985gkuk0000 --peer-asn 10000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBgpGroup

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the VBR. 

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
VBR所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the BGP group.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组的名称。

长度为2~128个字符，必须以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字，半角句号（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the BGP group.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
BGP组的描述信息。

长度为2~256个字符，必须以英文大小写字母或中文开头，但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The custom ASN on the Alibaba Cloud side. Valid values:

45104
64512 to 65534
4200000000 to 4294967294

65025 is reserved by Alibaba Cloud. The default value of LocalAsn on the Alibaba Cloud side is 45104. Using a custom LocalAsn in multi-line access scenarios may cause BGP routing loops. Evaluate the risks before you use this feature
parameters.help_zh:
自定义阿里云侧BGP AS号。取值：

45104
64512~65534
4200000000~4294967294

其中65025为阿里云保留值，阿里侧默认使用45104作为LocalAsn，使用自定义LocalAsn功能在多线接入场景时可能存在BGP路由环路风险，请合理评估后使用
parameters.name: local_asn

parameters.help_en: The ASN of the device on the on-premises data center side
parameters.name: peer_asn

parameters.help_en: The authentication key of the BGP group
parameters.name: auth_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a fake ASN. Valid values:

false (default): No.
true: Yes.

A router that runs BGP can belong to only one AS. When you need to replace an existing AS with a new one (for example, due to AS migration or merger with another AS) and cannot immediately modify the BGP configuration because of business or other objective factors, you can specify a fake ASN to establish a connection with the local end to ensure service continuity
parameters.help_zh:
是否指定伪AS号。取值：

false（默认值）：否。
true：是。

运行BGP的路由器一般只能属于一个AS。当需要用新的AS替代原有的AS（例如AS需要迁移或者和其他AS合并），并且因为业务等客观因素无法立即修改BGP配置时，可以通过指定伪AS号与本端建立连接，保证业务不中断
parameters.name: is_fake_asn

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

IPv4 (default): IPv4.
IPv6: IPv6. IPv6 is supported only when the VBR for which the BGP group is created has the enable IPv6 feature turned on
parameters.help_zh:
IP版本。取值：

IPv4（默认值）：IPv4版本。
IPv6：IPv6版本，只有当创建BGP组的VBR开通IPv6功能时，支持IPv6版本
parameters.name: ip_version

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of routes for a BGP peer. Unit: routes. Default value: 110
parameters.help_zh: BGP邻居的路由条目上限。单位：条，默认值：110
parameters.name: route_quota

schema.description_en: The ID of the created BGP group

BgpGroupId.description_en: The ID of the created BGP group
